active_learning_uncertainty_sampler.next: Use Stage7923-style confidence/margin diagnostics to drive 1m expansion cells.
active_learning_uncertainty_sampler.role: Prioritize new rows from uncertain/high-margin-conflict cells rather than bulk random mining.

contamination_leakage_detector.next: Consolidate shortcut/leak audits into a shared library used by all builders.
contamination_leakage_detector.role: Detect target leakage, heldout contamination, label-coded IDs, direct target fields, and source/body leakage.

context_window_packer.next: Build context-packing rows that teach retrieve/compress/drop decisions before long-context model work.
context_window_packer.role: Compress and arrange evidence from repo graph, retrieval, source spans, memory, and task state under fixed encoder limits.

cost_budget_scheduler.next: Convert budget evidence cards into an explicit scheduler/ranker module.
cost_budget_scheduler.role: Control token, retrieval, tool-call, and test budgets as part of the transition policy.

coverage_test_selection.next: Add no-execution coverage/test-selection cards for symbol-binding and patch-operator objectives.
coverage_test_selection.role: Map changed symbols to likely tests using coverage and repo graph features before runtime is opened.

dedup_near_duplicate_minhash.next: Add MinHash/simhash neighbor checks to every scale-manifest gate.
dedup_near_duplicate_minhash.role: Detect exact, semantic-key, and near-duplicate rows across train/eval/strict splits to avoid leakage and overcounted scale.

drift_canary_regression_monitor.next: Create cross-spine canaries from recovered stage clusters before scale expansion.
drift_canary_regression_monitor.role: Track whether new stages solve new gaps while preserving older 5k/6k/7k/8k lessons.

eval_harness_metrics_reporter.next: Use one metric-card schema across support modules, objectives, and training probes.
eval_harness_metrics_reporter.role: Standardize benchmark/run metrics so frontier comparisons are factual and not narrative-only.

flaky_test_detector.next: Add failure-stability metadata before using runtime failures as repair labels.
flaky_test_detector.role: Separate model/patch failures from unstable test outcomes before training failure labels are emitted.

golden_locked_eval_suite.next: Define fixed promotion/regression slices separate from dev-failure mining pools.
golden_locked_eval_suite.role: Maintain locked regression/hidden-style eval slices that are never mined back into training data.

hybrid_retrieval_fusion.next: Build no-authority retrieval fusion card before source-backed graph/symbol manifests.
hybrid_retrieval_fusion.role: Fuse lexical, dense, and reranker evidence so graph/symbol objectives do not depend on one fragile retrieval channel.

lost_in_middle_context_ranker.next: Create context-packing audit with evidence-present/evidence-dropped counterfactual rows.
lost_in_middle_context_ranker.role: Order retrieved evidence into a bounded context window so high-value source spans are not buried in the middle.

memory_retrieval_evaluator.next: Add memory quality gates before promoting mined traces into reusable skills.
memory_retrieval_evaluator.role: Evaluate whether stored traces/skills are useful, stale, duplicated, or contaminating heldout objectives.

mutation_adversarial_test_generator.next: Generate paired counterfactual rows for every active transition cell.
mutation_adversarial_test_generator.role: Create adversarial corruptions, wrong imports, wrong symbols, and near-miss patches that force robust transition learning.

patch_minimality_complexity_meter.next: Make minimality a patch-head and verifier-repair gate before body emission is reopened.
patch_minimality_complexity_meter.role: Score candidate edits for minimality, locality, complexity growth, and public API risk.

query_expansion_rewriter.next: Add query-expansion rows only after shortcut audit proves expansions do not encode target labels.
query_expansion_rewriter.role: Generate controlled alternate search queries from intent, symbol, error, and API hints without leaking target labels.

rubric_llm_judge_calibrator.next: Require judge/verifier disagreement accounting for any synthetic expansion or teacher label.
rubric_llm_judge_calibrator.role: Use rubrics and verifier disagreement as calibration signals, not as sole truth labels.

schema_drift_detector.next: Make alias parity a hard gate before every controller, graph, symbol, and decoder manifest.
schema_drift_detector.role: Detect old/new feature naming drift before model/controller handoff; Stage8058 failed until this was normalized.

secret_pii_leak_detector.next: Wire as a pre-judge corpus gate and a post-render gate before any source/body path opens.
secret_pii_leak_detector.role: Reject or redact secrets/PII in raw mined data, model-visible context, decoder targets, and final rendered outputs.

source_inventory_lineage_tracker.next: Implement Stage8655a as a reusable lineage tracker, not a one-off inventory.
source_inventory_lineage_tracker.role: Record source origin, hash, license, split eligibility, and transformation lineage for every mined row.

source_provenance_license_security_filte.next: Make source lineage mandatory for all 1m+ expansion manifests.
source_provenance_license_security_filte.role: Filter mined corpus rows by source lineage, license/security metadata, and allowed import provenance before curriculum admission.

static_analysis_security_scanner.next: Unify static analyzer outputs into the dataset judge route card.
static_analysis_security_scanner.role: Run syntax, AST, import, lint/type/security feature extraction without executing untrusted code.

tool_action_trajectory_analyzer.next: Mine traces into finite action/state rows only after lineage and leakage gates pass.
tool_action_trajectory_analyzer.role: Convert SWE-agent/Aider/Open-SWE traces into observe-orient-act transition labels and failure diagnoses.

weak_supervision_label_model.next: Add label-model manifest before accepting large synthetic/teacher-mined labels.
weak_supervision_label_model.role: Combine heuristic, verifier, teacher, retrieval, and judge votes into calibrated labels with abstain routes.

decision: Recovered additional support modules that are necessary for 1m+ scale curriculum expansion, source-backed graph/symbol learning, context packing, eval governance, and safe mining. This is no-authority indexing only.
next_best_step: Attach Stage8656 modules to the central graph, then implement source inventory, shared feature normalization, retrieval fusion, contamination/leakage, and locked-eval cards before any training reopen.
